Location is inside Atrium Saldanha shopping mall, next to Saldanha Metro station. Multiple coworker reviews praise the event support: 'Avila Spaces were unsurpassed in their help and support for the event. Without a shadow of a doubt, this is the place to be.' The space has dedicated event rooms with AV equipment.
